name: media/spotify-search-play
description: Search Spotify for something and play the top result.

steps.note: Cold or paused, Spotify's title is 'Spotify Premium'.

target.text: What do you want to play?
What do you want to play?

steps.note: Enter runs the full search and closes the suggestion dropdown.

MEASURED: the Top result card's big green button is named exactly 'Play' and sits above the player bar's own 'Play', so nth 1 in reading order is the top result. Song rows are 'Play <title>', which exact excludes.
